# Rising Sound WA Inc.

> Not-for-profit incorporated association formed by local musicians,
> supporting original musical and performance works across Western
> Australia. Puts on live music in venues, halls, parks and unexpected
> spaces, takes events to regional towns, films short concerts with
> original WA performers, and matches musicians with stages.

Rising Sound WA focuses on original music, not covers. Artists are paid,
and members' support keeps the free sessions free.

## What we do
- Saturday Sessions: free afternoon shows on the shop floor at Midland Records, 7 Spring Park Rd, Midland WA 6056, held when there's a suitable bill.
- Concerts and events: ticketed and free shows in venues, halls and public spaces, such as songwriters rounds at Midland Junction Arts Centre and Harmony in the Garden at The Two Birds garden, Darlington.
- Regional events: bringing original music to towns outside Perth.
- Rising Sound Sessions: "three songs, one take" filmed concerts with original WA performers, recorded at Midland Records. Sessions so far: Whiskey Jack, Moana Mayatrix, Vissac.
- Artist directory: original WA artists who are members and can be booked directly, including The Bloody Lovelies, Charlie & Goldie, Moana Mayatrix, The Pointy Heads, The Stumblers, Vissac and Whiskey Jack.

## Get involved
- Musicians: original work, any stage of career. Apply to play a session or join the artist directory.
- Venues and presenters: rooms, halls and public spaces that want original live music.
- Members and volunteers: membership helps keep the free sessions free.
